subject: dec-renderer-backends
text: - **[Renderer backends]** `paint_bench` supports `vello` (default), `cpu`/`vello_cpu`, `hybrid`/`vello_hybrid` (examples/paint_bench.rs:4-7; examples/paint_bench.rs:120-121; examples/paint_bench.rs:182; examples/paint_bench.rs:209), its vello backend configured with `use_cpu: false`, one init thread and area-only antialiasing (examples/paint_bench.rs:133-138); `screenshot` renders through `VelloCpuImageRenderer` (examples/screenshot.rs:108), and since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot so does blitz-test-harness's `screenshot` (`anyrender_vello_cpu` with no `multithreading`), which composites the frame over opaque white after paint where the example fills before `paint_scene` — the fill would need `kurbo` and `peniko`, which none of the harness's three raster dependencies re-exports (packages/blitz-test-harness/src/screenshot.rs:37-103); wpt `default = ["cpu"]`, `gpu` enabling `anyrender_vello` and `cpu` aliasing `VelloCpuImageRenderer` as `VelloImageRenderer` (wpt/runner/Cargo.toml:9-12; wpt/runner/src/main.rs:5-8); rdme selects one `WindowRenderer` alias per renderer feature (apps/readme/src/main.rs:32-43); `dioxus-native` raises a `compile_error!` when no renderer is enabled (packages/dioxus-native/src/dioxus_renderer.rs:9-29)

subject: dec-document-defaults
text: - **[Document defaults]** Incremental layout defaults to `true` (packages/blitz-dom/src/config.rs:56; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:505); CSS media type defaults to `screen` (packages/blitz-dom/src/config.rs:50-52; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:461); documents are always HTML in no-quirks mode (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:463; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1352; packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:167; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:257-263; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_device.rs:74; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/document.rs:129-133; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/element.rs:1072-1073); Stylo prefs enabled: grid, flexbox balance, unimplemented layout, columns, basic-shape `shape()`, tree-counting functions, `progress()`, variable fonts and, under the `writing-mode` feature, `layout.writing-mode.enabled`, with `layout.threads` -1 (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:448-458); the default `DocumentUrl` is an empty base64 `data:text/css` URL (packages/blitz-dom/src/url.rs:34-37); headless documents and the WPT viewport use `ColorScheme::Light` (examples/screenshot.rs:76-81; examples/paint_bench.rs:94-99; wpt/runner/src/main.rs:552-557)

subject: dec-resource-loading
text: - **[Resource loading]** `<head>` stylesheets are render-blocking critical resources and `resolve` returns before styling while any are pending (packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1288-1292; packages/blitz-dom/src/resolve.rs:52-63; tests/blitz-tests/tests/render_blocking_stylesheet.rs:3-8; tests/blitz-tests/tests/render_blocking_stylesheet.rs:53-55); a `<link>` starts loading once it has both `rel=stylesheet` and an `href` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/link_rel_attribute.rs:1-7); iframe nesting capped by `MAX_SUBDOCUMENT_DEPTH = 10` (packages/blitz-dom/src/iframe.rs:15-18; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1370-1377); nested `@import` capped by `MAX_IMPORT_DEPTH = 16` (packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:178-182; packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:205-213); an iframe's `srcdoc` takes precedence over `src` (packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1384-1389); loaded images are cached by URL with concurrent requests queued on one fetch (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:380-387; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1327-1352); author stylesheets are ordered by owner node id, with a TODO that node reuse could make that order wrong (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1389-1405; packages/blitz-dom/src/cssom.rs:288-290)

subject: dec-scrolling-and-input
dec-scrolling-and-input
text: - Seven direct engine changes for every document stand beside those eight, each ratified by the founder (2026-10-18): `inert` honoured and `disabled` read on a form control alone ([DOM semantics]); the builder's toggle read per role, the hit's stop at a `contain: paint` box and `Node::absolute_position` less its containing blocks' scroll alone (above); a click in a password `input` placing the caret by its bullets — `ClickTarget::TextInput` carries a `password` flag (an `input` whose `type` reads `password`, ASCII case-insensitive), and the private `click_password_input` lays out one U+2022 per character through `BaseDocument::layout_as_text_input`, scrolls that layout as paint scrolls it, finds the bullet under the point with parley's `Cursor::from_point` and moves the real editor to that character's byte offset — a click `move_to_byte`, a shift-click `extend_selection_to_byte`, two or more clicks `select_all` — every other text input keeping `move_to_point` on the editor's own layout (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:582-648); and the client rect read where an element's transforms move it (§Standard Contracts → Scrolling, selection, tree). `aria-activedescendant` stays unread and a box with no area stays hit at its centre, stated in `covered`'s meaning (§Standard Contracts → Driver session) — neither an engine change. Each of the seven is flagged upstreamable against upstream `main` at `23b9b26a9` with no upstream pull request open; their merge surface, by file (escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-18-engine-debts/evidence/merge-surface.md), is owned by a `.andromeda/residuals.md` line (target: next), re-read at the next upstream sync.

subject: dec-scrolling-and-input
text: - The document's clock stands beside the seven, ratified by the founder (2026-10-18): every engine time read — the overlay scrollbar fade, the double-click window, pan and the fling's generation, the smooth-scroll start, the fling and smooth frames — goes through `DocumentConfig.clock`, wall time when it is unset and a harness's `VirtualClock` headlessly, with `FADE_DELAY`, `FADE_DURATION`, the 500 ms and 2 px, the 300 ms smooth duration and the fling constants unchanged (§Standard Contracts → Document core); an API addition whose default keeps every windowed and embedder-built document's behaviour, flagged upstreamable against upstream `main` with no upstream pull request open, its merge surface — `packages/blitz-dom/src/{config,clock,document,resolve,iframe,scrolling}.rs` and `packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs` — owned by the same `.andromeda/residuals.md` line (target: next).

subject: dec-scrolling-and-input
text:
- The select model stands beside them, a direct engine change for every document, remote pages included: a focused single-choice `select` (no `multiple`) that is no disabled form control takes a pressed `ArrowDown` / `ArrowUp` to the next / previous enabled option and `Home` / `End` to the first / last (with none chosen, `ArrowDown` reads as `Home` and `ArrowUp` as `End`), and a character pressed with no Ctrl, Alt or Meta as typeahead — the first enabled option whose label starts with the buffered text, compared in lower case, the buffer (`select_typeahead`) starting afresh for another select or once the document's clock has moved 1 s (`TYPEAHEAD_TIMEOUT`); every other key does nothing — Enter and Space open nothing, and a released Space activates no select (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:108-113; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:165-200; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:248-269). A click on a select clears the typeahead and the document's text selection and focuses it through `generate_focus_events` / `set_focus_to`; the walk's disabled gate stops a disabled select first, so it neither focuses nor acts (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:857-870). Every choice that changes the chosen option goes through the one path `apply_select_choice` — the `CHECKED` write, the changed set, `input` then `change`, each carrying `select_value`, and a redraw — and a choice of the chosen option fires nothing (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:271-297). Its limits: no popup is painted, an option is not clicked (a driver `click` on one is refused `covered`), and a `multiple` select or an `optgroup`'s options are not modelled. Its choice model is [DOM semantics]'.
 Flagged upstreamable, with no upstream pull request open; its merge surface, by file — blitz-dom `node/select.rs`, `document.rs`, `events/{keyboard,pointer,mod}.rs`, `mutator.rs`, `accessibility.rs`, `form.rs`, `node/element.rs` and `assets/default.css`, blitz-traits `events.rs` and blitz-vibey-script `runtime.rs` — is owned by the same `.andromeda/residuals.md` line (target: next).

subject: dec-layout
text:
- **[Layout]** HTML tables are laid out by Taffy's grid through `TableTreeWrapper` (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/mod.rs:534-538; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/table.rs:770-789) with `GridAutoFlow::RowDense` (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/table.rs:223-228); fixed table layout only with `table-layout: fixed` and non-auto width, percentage columns only then (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/table.rs:232-236; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/table.rs:248-255); table-internal margins zeroed and `rowspan` clamped to 1..=65534 (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/table.rs:706-707; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/table.rs:630-634); table scrollable overflow capped at node size, marked `HACK` (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/mod.rs:569-577); replaced elements are `img`, `svg`, `canvas`, `video`, `embed`, `iframe`, `<object>` excluded so fallback children render (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/replaced.rs:7-17); atomic inline boxes add `input`, `textarea`, `button` (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/replaced.rs:441-448); default object size 300x150, an unloaded image zero (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/mod.rs:41-46; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/mod.rs:58-60; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/svg.rs:217-224; tests/blitz-tests/tests/custom_widget_layout.rs:69-78; tests/blitz-tests/tests/custom_widget_layout.rs:102-111); text nodes are never laid out individually (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/mod.rs:244-257); text inputs get a Parley editor, checkbox/radio get checkbox data (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/construct.rs:432-449) and, since 2026-10-13-range-input-interaction, a range input gets `RangeInputData`, seeded from its sanitized `value` attribute only when it holds none — so a re-construction keeps a moved value — and cleared to `None` when the element no longer reads `type="range"`, construction then continuing as before with no early return (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/construct.rs:427;
 packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/construct.rs:929-947; [Scrolling and input]), the editor constructed with size 16.0 (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/text.rs:85-92); floats compile only with `floats` (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/inline/layout.rs:16-19; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/inline/layout.rs:405-408); damage bits `ONLY_RELAYOUT`, `REORDER_CHILDREN`, `CONSTRUCT_BOX`, `CONSTRUCT_FC`, `CONSTRUCT_DESCENDENT`, `ALL_DAMAGE` over Servo's `RestyleDamage`, `REORDER_CHILDREN` not part of `ALL_DAMAGE` (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/damage.rs:23-44); display/float/position/contain/visibility/font/text-shaping changes yield `ALL_DAMAGE`, an in-flow `order` change `RELAYOUT | REORDER_CHILDREN`, else `RELAYOUT` (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/damage.rs:361-466); flex/grid children stable-sorted by `order`, skipped when all are 0 (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/damage.rs:468-479; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/construct.rs:565-566), kept persistently sorted (tests/blitz-tests/tests/flex_grid_order.rs:1-4), abspos children keying as `order` 0 (tests/blitz-tests/tests/flex_grid_order.rs:149-155); z-index-auto positioned boxes share one paint level and only non-zero z-index stacking contexts are hoisted (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/paint_tree.rs:420-462; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/paint_tree.rs:338-346); out-of-flow boxes are painted and hit-tested by their containing block (tests/blitz-tests/tests/paint_tree_incremental.rs:489-491), hoisted offsets computed at most once per geometry generation (tests/blitz-tests/tests/paint_tree_incremental.rs:275-316)

subject: dec-dom-semantics
text:
- **[DOM semantics]** `lang`/`xml:lang` set language through Stylo's `-x-lang`, `xml:lang` winning (tests/blitz-tests/tests/lang_attribute.rs:1-2; tests/blitz-tests/tests/lang_attribute.rs:47-78); `dir` sets CSS direction per the HTML bidi rendering section (tests/blitz-tests/tests/dir_attribute.rs:1-6); `disabled` is read one way, by its presence — bare, `"false"` or `"true"` — on a form control alone (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18): `ElementData::is_disabled` is `can_be_disabled()` (`button` · `input` · `select` · `textarea`) and a `disabled` attribute present, and focusability (`ElementData::flush_is_focussable`), the pointer-move gate, `ClickTarget::Disabled`, `handle_click`'s walk gate and the Enter and Space activation gates read it, so `disabled="false"` on a form control removes its focusability while a `<div disabled tabindex=0>` takes focus, a `<summary disabled>` or an `<a href disabled>` takes Enter, Space and a click, and a disabled ancestor `div` does not stop `handle_click`'s walk (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:514-518; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:733; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:326; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:459; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:757; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:205; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:222; tests/blitz-tests/tests/focusability_updates.rs:59-62; tests/blitz-tests/tests/focusability_updates.rs:78-96; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:614-655); the `DISABLED`/`ENABLED` element state (hence Stylo `:disabled`) keys on the attribute's presence (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:480-485); the Tab walk (`focus_next_node` / `focus_prev_node`), autofocus and `DioxusDocument::unkeyed_actionable` move with focusability, and the recompute on a `disabled` write is unchanged;
 a node the Dioxus bridge removes is dropped with its descendants and their `element_id_mapping` / `node_id_mapping` entries are cleared, so a re-render-removed node no longer resolves — upstream #1185, merged at 2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship; until then the mappings were intentionally not cleared on removal so dioxus-core could reuse detached nodes (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_writer.rs:110-130; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:498-532) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship/report.md; hit-test results canonicalize anonymous blocks and pseudo-element subtrees to their element, hover re-resolved after each `resolve` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/interaction_state_canonicalization.rs:5-10); interaction state on removed nodes is cleared (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stale_interaction_state.rs:11-14), hover/active retargeting to the nearest surviving ancestor and focus resetting to the body (tests/blitz-tests/tests/interaction_state_teardown.rs:6-14); transforms are stored in device-pixel space with translation scaled once (tests/blitz-tests/tests/transform_viewport_scale.rs:1-5); `scrollable_overflow` stored in device pixels, unscaled by `Node::hit()` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/details_element.rs:108-113)

subject: dec-dom-semantics
text: - `inert` is honoured by its presence on the element or an ancestor element (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18): `Node::is_focussable` also reads false for an inert node through the crate-private `Node::is_inert`, an ancestor walk, so the cached `ElementData::is_focussable` stays per element and no mutator hook is added, and the Tab walk `focus_next_node` / `focus_prev_node`, autofocus (`process_added_subtree`) and `DioxusDocument::unkeyed_actionable` skip it; `hit_inner` answers no hit at an element carrying `inert`, before any other test, so a hit passes through it; the accessibility builder's `is_hidden_from_accessibility_tree` reads true for it, so the subtree leaves the tree and the snapshot (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:563-580; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1437-1446; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:256; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:260-273; tests/blitz-tests/tests/inert_subtree.rs:68-194). A known limit: HTML's focus fixup is not built — a node that holds focus when it becomes inert keeps it until focus moves (pinned by `inert_subtree::removing_inert_restores_focus_hit_and_tree`), its fix owned by a `.andromeda/residuals.md` line (target: next).

subject: dec-dom-semantics
text:
- A `select`'s choice is held as its options' `CHECKED` element state, so `:checked` matches the chosen option; an option created with a `selected` attribute is seeded `CHECKED` (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:472-478). The rules, in the crate-private `node/select.rs` cited to the WHATWG `select` element: a select's options are its `option` children in tree order (an `optgroup`'s are not listed); an option's label is its non-empty `label` attribute, else its stripped and collapsed text, and its value its `value` attribute when present, else the text; a single-choice select is settled by HTML's selectedness setting algorithm — the last chosen option, else the first option not disabled (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/select.rs:70-86; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/select.rs:117-139; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/select.rs:155-164). The mutator records every select whose children an entry point touches and every select entering the document — a Dioxus static template is deep-cloned, so its options never pass an append —; a `selected` write sets that option chosen and its select's other options not, a cleared one sets it not chosen, and `flush` settles every recorded select, firing no event (packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1025-1028; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1105-1109; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1219-1223; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1228-1249). Dioxus writes a dynamic `selected` again on each re-render, so a controlled app writes `selected` from its `input` event's value or a choice reverts (as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-20-select-by-id/report.md). Form submission sends every chosen option that is not disabled, by its value (packages/blitz-dom/src/form.rs:276-290).
 The accessibility builder keeps an option whose parent is a `select` although it computes `display: none` — `hidden`, `inert` and `visibility: hidden` still exclude it —, writes its `selected` from its chosen state with no `aria-selected` read, and takes its non-empty `label` attribute as its `label` where it has no `aria-label` (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:157-162; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:171-181; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:257-258; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:260-273). The user-agent stylesheet gives `select` the border, padding and background of `input, textarea` and `display: inline-block`, and shows a single-choice select's chosen option by `select:not([multiple]) > option:checked { display: inline; }` beside `option { display: none; }`, so a select lays out as a box holding its chosen option (packages/blitz-dom/assets/default.css:77-78; packages/blitz-dom/assets/default.css:84-86; packages/blitz-dom/assets/default.css:155-159). Its keys and its click are [Scrolling and input]'s.

subject: dec-painting
text: - **[Painting]** Layers capped at `LAYER_LIMIT = 1024` (packages/blitz-paint/src/layers.rs:6; packages/blitz-paint/src/layers.rs:60-64); non-finite or > f32::MAX transformed boxes culled (packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs:404-419); gradient layers needing more than 500 tiles not painted, with a FIXME (packages/blitz-paint/src/render/background.rs:589-592); mask isolation uses opacity 1.0 - f32::EPSILON to force an isolated buffer (packages/blitz-paint/src/render/mask.rs:29-35); a uniform solid border with circular corners is one stroke, partly to work around Vello seams (packages/blitz-paint/src/render/border.rs:154-164); since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot a password input paints masked in every document — blitz-paint's mask over blitz-dom's `layout_as_text_input` (§Standard Contracts → Paint and shell), a direct engine change for every document beside those under [Scrolling and input], ratified by the founder (2026-10-12, «Движок маскирует», by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer); before it the engine laid out and painted a password input's characters like any text input's, confirmed on a frame (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-headless-screenshot/evidence/controls.md); its merge surface with upstream is `packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs` and `packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs`

subject: dec-driver-session
text:
- **[Driver session]** A session crosses processes on a `std`-only Unix-domain socket in an owner-only state directory — no third-party IPC, named-pipe, pid-file or daemonizing crate and no TCP or UDP port (the founder's choice, 2026-10-07, relayed verbatim); the socket carries the session's lifecycle and, since 2026-10-10-driver-cli, a driver call and its answer — a call takes an element id and typed text in, an answer takes ids, accessible names, control values (a password's or a file input's as the fixed mask), the snapshot's text and the diff out, and no `NodeId` crosses — where until then it carried lifecycle messages only and nothing of the screen: a boundary widening ratified by the founder (2026-10-10, by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label «Сокет несёт команды»; the English wording is the overseer's); Windows has no `std` local socket, so the cross-process lifecycle and a call sent across it return `Unsupported` there in 0.1.0 while a session held in process works on every target (packages/escher-driver/src/lib.rs:14-25). The session library takes the app's boot from its caller and depends on no app: no manifest under `packages/` names an example, and the one edge runs `seven_guis → escher-driver` (packages/escher-driver/Cargo.toml:13-18; examples/seven_guis/Cargo.toml:35).
 The library names one feature, `accessibility` on `dioxus-native-dom`, unconditionally and with no `[features]` table of its own — decided by 2026-10-07-act-by-id, the entry that first reads the snapshot through a session: its executor cannot be built without the snapshot model — so through `seven_guis → escher-driver` both seven_guis binaries, `seven_guis_native` and `escher-session`, compile dioxus-native-dom's accessibility modules and still build no platform adapter: `accesskit_xplat` and `accesskit_winit` are in neither graph and `Cargo.lock` did not change at that chunk (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-act-by-id/evidence/feature-reach.md, on the dev host's target); it depends on five crates — blitz-test-harness, dioxus-native-dom, since 2026-10-07-driver-command-spans `tracing` (`{ workspace = true }`, no cargo feature — answered by the operator, 2026-10-07, at that chunk's plan forks; `Cargo.lock` gained one line for it, `"tracing",` in the escher-driver entry, and no package) and, since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface, `serde_json` (`{ workspace = true }`, no feature and no `[features]` table of its own, a reader of MCP requests, of kept checks and of the live answer line a replay compares, writing nothing — the founder, 2026-10-10, «serde_json, только чтение», by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label, the English wording is the overseer's; `Cargo.lock` gained one line, `"serde_json",` in the escher-driver entry, and no package — it was already in both graphs through dioxus-html — and no platform adapter entered: packages/escher-driver/Cargo.toml:17; Cargo.toml:165; Cargo.lock:3099) and, since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot, `png` (the workspace's, resolved 0.18.1, already in the graph
 — no package entered `Cargo.lock`), the encoder of a shot, its base64 written by hand with no crate taken for it — the key types its `press` needs come through the harness's re-exports `Key`, `Modifiers` and, since the 2026-10-17 upstream sync's keyboard-types 0.8, `NamedKey` — `keyboard_key` maps each of the 11 named keys to `Key::Named(NamedKey::…)`, Space staying `Character(" ")`, and the macOS `ACTION_MODIFIER` reads `Modifiers::META` (packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:540; packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:568-572; packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:574-579) — not a dependency of their own — it opens one `tracing` span per call handed to `Session::run` and, since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface, one `tool_call` span per MCP `tools/call` request, holding `tool` and `ending` only (the founder, 2026-10-10, «Span с tool и ending», relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label; the English wording is the overseer's), and emits no event (§Standard Contracts → Driver session), installs no subscriber, reads no env var and has no default state location; a hosted session expires — `serve` takes an idle expiry, `IDLE_EXPIRY` (1,800 s) for a host a command line starts, and a host that has answered no request for that long ends exactly as on `stop`, every answered request, a refused or malformed one included, starting the count again (the founder's answer to the orphaned-host question, 2026-10-10, relayed by the overseer; until 2026-10-10-driver-cli a session had no idle expiry); since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface a session's calls also cross from an MCP client over the `escher-session mcp` role's stdio — a child of that client, local to the invoking user, holding its session in its own process with no listener
 — the request-id echo (an integer, or a string of at most 128 bytes), a request line of at most 65,536 bytes and a result of at most 1,048,576 bytes its bounds: a boundary widening ratified by the founder (2026-10-10, «Ратифицировать как есть», by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label; the English wording is the overseer's); since 2026-10-12-self-description the command line's stdout and the `mcp` role's stdio also carry the program's own fixed text, held as `'static` data of the one table — the `help` self-description, a session error's remedy and each tool's description with its result fields — riding those ratified carriers, while text from a page, a call or a screen, a new carrier or a new exit still widens; a changed node's `differs` crosses as a closed set by the rule of 2026-10-10; no dependency added, `serde_json` still a reader only — ratified by the founder (2026-10-12, «Внутри, с правилом» and «help — десятый глагол», by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer; the wrap's card confirmed, «Подтвердить всё», the same channel); since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot a shot's pixels cross in band on those carriers — its PNG as base64 inside the answer on the session socket and the command line's stdout, and as an MCP `image` block on the `mcp` role's stdio — screen content and no closed value set, with no new carrier, exit or path argument and the 1,048,576-byte bounds unchanged, a bigger image ending `oversize` / `AnswerTooLarge` (the largest whole-screen answer on the stand measured 22,404 bytes, 2.1 % of the bound): a boundary widening ratified by the founder (2026-10-12, «В самом ответе», by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer; the wrap's card confirmed, «Подтвердить все 16», the same channel);
 a lint's findings cross on those carriers and rest in a kept check as the `lint` verb's answer — stable ids, the closed defect words and numbers, no page text, colour, control value or `NodeId` — with no new carrier, exit, path argument, cause, session error, span field or dependency: a ratified boundary widening; a screen over the snapshot budget crosses them in parts — `snapshot`'s optional `part` (a whole number, 1 to `MAX_PART` = 1000) in, one part's text with the closed counts `part` and `parts` out, a part past the last the empty text, a screen within the budget answering whole as before, over MCP a paged answer its JSON line — with no new verb, carrier, exit, cause, session error, span field or dependency: a ratified boundary widening — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-session/report.md, the `tracing` dependency and the span at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md, the call on the wire and the idle expiry at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-driver-cli/report.md, the MCP crossing, `serde_json` and the `tool_call` span at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-mcp-surface/report.md, the fixed text on the carriers at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-self-description/report.md, the in-band shot and `png` at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-headless-screenshot/report.md, the lint's findings on the carriers at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-19-visual-lint/report-gated.md, the paged screen at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-20-large-screen-in-parts/report.md

subject: dec-driver-session
text: - A session whose launcher names a recording directory keeps its answered calls at rest as one owner-only replayable check — `std` only, no dependency added, unix only like the socket: the calls as they crossed (target ids, a `press` key, an `advance`'s ms, text typed into an unmasked control), a masked or unresolved `type` as one fixed stand-in, each answer as a 64-bit digest and kept whole — its line as the driver wrote it, masked as on every carrier, a shot's without its pixels — so a kept check holds the screens' ids, names, values, snapshot text and diffs at rest, never logged and never named by a tool call; a kept check replays through `Session::run` alone (`Check::replay`), and the repository's own two scripted stand checks are committed in git, the one exception to owner-only.
